description:
One business the user NAMED, matched by its name near `location` (default radius 15 miles); typos, word order and punctuation are tolerated.
Not in the catalogue → `name_not_found`, and up to 5 nearby businesses that carry the name's distinctive word (never presented as the business asked for).
`intent`, `query`, `needed_by`, `deliver_to` shape the short card the same way as list_cards.
Follow the server instructions «HOW TO USE THE VERSUM CATALOG»: results are candidates, not proof; keep reading, quoting, requesting and ordering separate; nothing is sent to an owner, booked, ordered or paid without the user’s permission.

deliver_to.description: where it must be brought (a postcode is best): the card says confirmed / refuted / unknown

intent.description: what the user means to do with this business

location.description: a postcode, a city or "lat,lng" — orders the matches by nearness and bounds the nearby list

name.description: the business name as the user said it

needed_by.description: when: «sunday», «tomorrow 19:00», «now», «tomorrow after 15:00» — read on the business’s own clock, three ways (on_day / open_at / slot_after)

query.description: the thing under the task («red roses», «ribeye»): picks the ≤ 5 items on the card

name: find_business
title: A business by its name
